verses.1: Please recite to my friend the song of my father’s vineyard. It was a vineyard that belonged to my friend, under the care of Benjamin.
verses.2: And she nourished him, cared for him, and raised him. She built a house for him inside it. There was also a vineyard in that place. He planted fruit trees there, and he cultivated them with fire.
verses.3: And now, when he sits in Jerusalem, let the people of Judah judge between me and Karmi.
verses.4: What should I do now? I haven’t done anything yet. I decided to plant fruit trees. But they were destroyed by fire.
verses.5: And now, I would like to tell you what I am doing for my vineyard: I’m removing it from its hiding place. It will become a wild field with large trees, and it will become a beautiful place.
verses.6: And she made him a daughter who would not sing, nor would she be awakened. And there was darkness and gloom over him; and from the sky, rain fell upon him.
verses.7: For the army of Jehovah is in the house of Israel, and every Jew has planted his seed. They seek justice and righteousness. But behold, there is a cry of wailing.
verses.8: Oh, those who come into the house in the field! They will bring it to an even distance from where they stand. Then they will return alone, near to the ground.
verses.9: In the ears of Jehovah’s armies, if not in many houses, they will be great and good, compared to those who dwell there.
verses.10: For twelve branches of the vine will be made into one, and the seed of wheat will be made into one also.
verses.11: May the reward descend upon them in the morning, after the wicked have been punished by YHVH.
verses.12: And they shall be like a lamp and a torch; they shall shine brightly. But they shall not look at the works of Jehovah, nor see His hands.
verses.13: Therefore, my people became hungry and thirsty because of their lack of knowledge and wisdom.
verses.14: So, Shaul’s heart became filled with joy, and her lips trembled with emotion. Her face became pale, and her eyes became sad and dark.
verses.15: And man shall be humbled, and one shall be despised. And the eyes of those who are high will be lowered.
verses.16: And Jehovah raised His armies for judgment; and the Holy One, Blessed Be He, was sanctified in righteousness.
verses.17: And they became like worms, as they said; and their ruins were eaten by wild animals.
verses.18: Oh, how miserable is the state of those who are trapped in the bonds of sin and corruption!
verses.19: Let them hurry up and act quickly, so that the Holy Spirit of Israel may be revealed and come forth. Then we will know what has been done.
verses.20: Oh, those who say that good becomes evil, and evil becomes good! They place darkness in the light, and light in darkness. They make one bitter from bitterness, and bitterness from sweetness.
verses.21: May the wise ones be in their own eyes, and against their own faces, they are destroyed.
verses.22: Oh, rulers! You drink wine and the people of the tribe drink for the sake of their wages.
verses.23: The righteous will be punished for their sins, but the righteousness of the righteous will be forgiven by God.
verses.24: Therefore, it is difficult for them to eat fire and they fear that their roots will be destroyed. Their flowers will wither away, for they have abandoned the laws of Jehovah’s army and the words of the Lord of Israel.
verses.25: Therefore, Jehovah struck that people with his hand, and they were destroyed. The mountains also trembled, and they became ruins. In all this, His hand remained still; it did not move at all.
verses.26: And the angel of God will go into the nations from afar, and Sharak will be with him from every corner of the earth. And soon, it will be easy for him to do so.
verses.27: There is no wear and tear on it; it doesn’t need to be washed or cleaned. Its seams won’t break, and its soles won’t crack either.
verses.28: Its two halves are different in shape, and all its branches follow curved paths. Its hooves are considered to be sharp as thorns. Its legs are like claws.
verses.29: It barks like a dog; it barks loudly, and it grabs its prey. It doesn’t stop until it has caught its prey.
verses.30: And on that day, it will be like the noise of the sea; it will be destroyed and fallen to the ground. Then, there will be darkness everywhere, and light will be hidden in its depths.
